name: gameplay-cinema-pause
origin: The pause screen (checkpoint 4, slice b2): the round of gameplay-cinema-start (seed 42, Arcade, Normal, Cinema, robot 0) with the AI robots stopped at its first frame (fixture, as gameplay-cinema-bomb). Ten frames in, P (keyCode 80) calls Game.gamePause, which waits 100 ms (setTimeout doGamePause): PauseUI (class UI_pause) then joins the UI container, the board container is hidden and the engine stops. pause: 8 frames after P; paused: 30 frames later (its loops play on).
godot_note: Godot starts on the recorded round (round cinema-start) and stops its AI robots with the Godot-only ai-stop action.

actions.godot_note: The app does not reproduce the menus' Math.random draws, so the round this START opens replays the original's generator from the recording (math_random.json) and rolls its board from the original's draws (Layouts.roll_set: it must equal the golden's boxes and frames); the enemy robots come from the golden of the cinema-start capture (App.round_as_recorded).
AIControl.stop through the original's own method (fixture); Godot gives the robot no commands, as it then has none.
